summary: The current manifest, implementation, deterministic post-actor results, and workspace patch evidence agree: only moldea/moldea.yaml changed, direct bindings target the existing support implementation, and the dynamic tool relationship is preserved as an agent-level warning.

requirements.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml binds runtimeAgent to /src/support-assistant.ts#supportAssistant and instructionLoader to /src/support-assistant.ts#loadSupportInstruction. src/support-assistant.ts exports both symbols and passes the loaded canonical instruction to client.responses.create. src/support-agent.ts is absent. Workspace assertions show only moldea/moldea.yaml changed while src/support-assistant.ts remained unchanged; deterministic validation, inspection, and typechecking passed.

moldea/moldea.yaml records agents.support.unresolved.dynamic-tool-registry-wiring with effect warning, explains that static inspection cannot establish the relationship, gives the concrete resolution of closing runtime wiring or adding an integration test, and relates /src/dynamic-tools.ts#assembleTools. The implementation exports assembleTools, while the manifest invents no tool or capability binding. Workspace assertions show the implementation remained unchanged and only the manifest changed; deterministic inspection and validation passed.
